IPA II Western Balkans beneficiaries have taken concrete steps in the implementation of electoral recommendations in 5 thematic areas by the end of the action 2023

At the end of the reporting period the project scope included the final reports from 30 EOAs and 731 recommendations 716 98 per cent relate to the thematic areas of the project. Of these 487 68 per cent were evaluated out of which 259 53 per cent have been implemented to a certain extent. This represents an increase of 2 compared to the end of the first year and of 4 compared to the start of the project.

IPA II Western Balkans beneficiaries have taken concrete steps in the implementation of electoral recommendations in 5 thematic areas by the end of the action July 2024

At the end of the reporting period the project scope included the final reports from 30 EOAs and 731 recommendations 716 98 per cent relate to the thematic areas of the project. Of these 487 68 per cent were evaluated out of which 259 53 per cent have been implemented to a certain extent. This represents an increase of 2 compared to the end of the first year and of 4 compared to the start of the project.
